messages:
Ellen Park: Proposal: trial a 7-day postmortem follow-up cadence ("sprintlet") to keep action items from drifting. owners have a 7-day SLA.
Marcus Hill: sounds reasonable. do we force owners or allow volunteers?
Ellen Park: assign by IC before channel unlock; teams can swap but a named owner must exist.
Samira Khan: add a verification owner separate from implementer. helps avoid blind closes.
Jordan Lee: recommend ticket fields: incident, owner, verification_owner, due_date, recurrence_risk, complexity, rollback_plan, monitoring_window.
oncall-bot: Suggested label: "pmr-7d". Reminders: day3 and day6; escalate day8.
Marcus Hill: rotation thought: keep IC rotation weekly, remediation owner rotation per sprintlet or via team's 2-week rota. IC shouldn't do remediations by default.
Samira Khan: for recurrence_risk=high, add a mandatory 90-day monitoring window and quarterly review.
Ellen Park: pilot plan: 6 weeks, infra/runtime/platform. success metrics: % closed in 7d, compliance with updates, recurrence at 30/60/90 days.
Jordan Lee: I'll mock a Grafana panel + a JQL filter for the dashboard.
Marcus Hill: automation: require 1-line status update before Tue pulse or auto-poke.
Ellen Park: I'll draft the playbook + sample ticket template and post in #eng-oncall tomorrow. volunteers DM me. :raised_hands:
